Slice the celery and halve the grapes.Fold everything through the dressing with most of the walnuts.Pile onto cos leaves and finish with the last walnuts and snipped chives.MainsKris Kringle's Thanksgiving turkeyHerb butter roast turkey breast with cornbread stuffingHow to make it1.5kg turkey breast120g butter, soft (60g mixed with herbs)1 small bunch sage, chopped300g cornbread1 onion, diced2 celery sticks, diced1 egg450ml chicken stock1kg potatoes100ml full cream milk150g cranberry sauce1 orange, zested1 tbsp plain flourMash some butter with sage and push it under the skin of the turkey.Roast at 180°C.Fry the onion and celery, crumble in the cornbread and mix with sage, egg and some stock. Bake in a dish for the last part of the roasting.Boil the potatoes and mash with butter and milk.Simmer the cranberry sauce with the orange zest.Rest the turkey and make gravy from the juices with the flour and remaining stock.SweetsNew York pumpkin pie with maple creamPumpkin pie in a crisp crust, served with maple creamHow to make it1 sheet shortcrust pastry600g butternut pumpkin, peeled150g brown sugar2 eggs400ml thickened cream2 tsp ground cinnamon1 tsp ground ginger1 pinch ground nutmeg2 tbsp maple syrup50g pecans, toastedLine a 23cm pie dish with the pastry and bake blind at 190°C.Steam the pumpkin until soft, drain well and mash smooth.Beat the pumpkin with the sugar, eggs, some of the cream, the cinnamon, ginger and nutmeg.
